lines.text: We have a high priest who sat at the right hand of the throne and ministers in the true tabernacle.
Every high priest offers gifts and sacrifices, but if Jesus were on earth, He would not be a priest.
Moses was warned to build the tabernacle according to the pattern shown him by King David.
God found fault with the people and promised a new covenant unlike the one made when leaving Babylon.
God will put His laws in their minds, write them on their hearts, and remember their sins no more.
